text: The steep streets under the castle. Patricians and the emperor's officers live in stone houses, and the Tiergärtnertor opens to the north-west.
The north half of the town, round St. Sebald, the town hall and the Hauptmarkt. The richest merchants build their houses here.
The south half of the town, round St. Lorenz. Königstraße runs down from the river to the Königstor.
The east of the Lorenz side, with the Mauthalle, St. Klara and the workshops toward the Marientor.
Houses and gardens on the road out of the Marientor.
The road south out of the Königstor, past the gallows hill.
Houses along the road out of the Frauentor.
The road west out of the Spittlertor toward Fürth.
Mills and houses outside the Hallertor.
Gardens and houses outside the Neutor.
St. Johannis, with its churchyard where Dürer is buried, out past the Tiergärtnertor.
Wöhrd, a village of weavers outside the Laufer Tor.
A vintners’ village on the terraces of the Rebenberg, under Burg Himmelsfels. Its lanes climb the hill in flights of steps.
